title: Procrastinate
summary: PROCRAS'TINATE, verb transitive [Latin procrastinor; pro and crastinus; cras, to-morrow.] To put off from day to day; to delay; to defer to a future time; as, to procrastinate repentance. PROCRAS'TINA

inlines.v: PROCRAS'TINATE, verb transitive [Latin procrastinor; pro and crastinus; cras, to-morrow.] To put off from day to day; to delay; to defer to a future time; as, to procrastinate repentance. PROCRAS'TINATE, verb intransitive To delay; to be dilatory. I procrastinate more than I did twenty years ago.
